config-manager-recovery.recovery.banner: Configuration changes are protected: there is an unfinished recovery item. Resolve it before continuing.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.requiredHint: An operation did not complete normally. To stay safe, all config-modifying operations are paused. Handle the recovery item(s) below to restore normal operation.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.incident.title: What happened
config-manager-recovery.recovery.currentState.title: Current state
config-manager-recovery.recovery.currentState.safeModeCleared: Restored to normal — you can continue
config-manager-recovery.recovery.snapshot.title: Recovery snapshot
config-manager-recovery.recovery.environment.title: Environment
config-manager-recovery.recovery.environment.incompatible: Environment mismatch (may be from another machine / install)
config-manager-recovery.recovery.preview.title: Recovery preview
config-manager-recovery.recovery.preview.hint: Read-only preview below (zero writes). Recovery only runs after confirmation.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.preview.empty: No restorable actions for this operation (or all skipped).
config-manager-recovery.recovery.confirm.title: Confirm recovery
config-manager-recovery.recovery.confirm.message: Recovery / rollback is a dangerous operation. Confirm execution? Current files are backed up to a safe location first.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.confirm.rollbackContinue: Continue the interrupted rollback (already-completed parts are skipped and not redone).
config-manager-recovery.recovery.confirm.retry: Retry recovery after verification failure. Confirm running it again?
config-manager-recovery.recovery.confirm.dismiss: Abandon recovery? The operation will be set aside (quarantined), and the related snapshot and operation records are kept, but it will not be auto-recovered.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.verify.title: Verification result
config-manager-recovery.recovery.verify.verdict.match: Verified: target state matches the trusted snapshot
config-manager-recovery.recovery.verify.verdict.partial: Verified (partial match): core state matches, but some items could not be auto-verified
config-manager-recovery.recovery.verify.verdict.mismatch: Verification failed: target state does not match the trusted snapshot; recovery incomplete
config-manager-recovery.recovery.verify.verdict.error: Verification error: could not reliably complete verification; recovery incomplete
config-manager-recovery.recovery.needsAttention.title: Needs attention
config-manager-recovery.recovery.needsAttention.hint: Recovery could not complete or verification failed. Review the reason, then retry or abandon.
config-manager-recovery.recovery.runningHint: Recovery / rollback is running; keep this page open.
config-manager-recovery.section.label: Аварийное восстановление
config-manager-recovery.section.description: Восстановление профилей и откат к предыдущим снапшотам
